cross_context_replay_forbidden: certificate with a certified role not equal to the embedded projection root role
world-evaluation receipt used directly as binding authority
binding_authority_certificate.derivation_rule: For each binding observation, independently derive the raw projection trace from the exact raw binding expression and frozen source-role authority. Do not copy or transform the world-evaluation receipt.
binding_authority_certificate.embedded_projection_authority: The embedded projection certificate must satisfy the exact Gate2C7/Gate2C5 opaque projection authority rules and unique-match requirement.
binding_authority_certificate.wrapper_digest: SHA-256 canonical JSON of the complete binding wrapper payload.

decision_rule.candidate_c1_rerun_authorized_only_if: The complete adversarial synthetic matrix passes in producer and independent checker, dual replay is byte-identical, raw evidence retention is exact, and no forbidden surface is modified or read.
decision_rule.exact_seven_success: All seven frozen Python cases attain VALID_C1; each expected refined raw origin remains unchanged; every newly consumed A3 role equivalence is backed by one exact binding-scoped certificate; no A4 result or non-role A3 obligation changes.
decision_rule.on_any_exact_seven_failure: Freeze the first-complete result unchanged, keep Candidate58 additive requalification unauthorized, and diagnose the next proximal blocker without post-hoc rule changes.
decision_rule.on_exact_seven_success: Immutably freeze the Gate2C8 repaired C1 lane before any Candidate58 additive requalification.

execution_sequence: freeze this prospective protocol as a protocol-only commit whose sole parent is the Gate2C7 post-projection diagnosis commit
implement the minimal C1-local binding-authority producer/consumer plus a separate independent checker
run adversarial synthetic qualification with zero Candidate58 C1 executions
immutably freeze successful synthetic qualification before candidate execution
run exactly the frozen seven Python C1 development cases and no other Candidate58 case
immutably freeze the first-complete exact-seven result whether promotable or non-promotable
only if exact-seven success rule is satisfied, freeze repaired lane and then authorize a separately receipted Candidate58 additive requalification

hypothesis.falsifiable_prediction: Under the frozen seven Python C1 development cases, if the only remaining disagreement is unauthorized A3 role comparison, then a synthetically qualified binding-scoped authority consumer will make A3 role comparison determinate without changing raw origins, lineage, producer bytes, world evaluation, A4 semantics, or any non-role-comparison A3 obligation.
hypothesis.statement: A raw refined binding origin that is not literally equal to an allowed base role can satisfy A3 role identity only through a binding-scoped typed authority proving that the exact raw origin is a canonical projection of a certified base role derived independently of the binding's allowed set; the A3 consumer then compares that certified role to frozen allowed_origins. This authority is a semantic comparison witness, not a rewrite of raw evidence.

implementation_contract.minimal_change_rule: Any implementation must be the smallest change that makes the typed A3 consumer explicit; convenience refactors outside the permitted surface are forbidden before first-complete qualification.
permitted_production_surface: new C1-local binding-authority consumer module if needed
risu_e2_c1/source_extract.py only to independently emit binding-scoped authority receipts while retaining existing raw evidence
risu_e2_c1/semantics.py only to replace raw-string A3 allowed-vs-observed comparison with the frozen typed binding relation

independence_contract.independent_checker: A separate stdlib-AST checker must reconstruct the binding wrapper and role relation from raw synthetic source without importing the production binding-authority consumer or Gate2C7 projection helper.
independence_contract.production_derivation: Binding authority must originate in the independent C1 raw-source lane and may not import or call the primary adapter or producer kernel.

population.prospective_protection_applies_to: Gate2C8 implementation, synthetic qualification, and any new exact-seven C1 rerun; not to historical source-byte secrecy.

purpose: Permit A3 claim-critical allowed-vs-observed role comparison to consume a binding-scoped projection authority only when the raw refined origin is independently and uniquely certified as a canonical projection of an allowed base role; raw origin, lineage, source evidence, and all non-A3 semantics remain unchanged.

binding_relation.CERTIFIED_NONMATCH: one internally valid binding-scoped receipt binds the exact raw_origin to a uniquely certified canonical role derived independently of allowed_origins, and that certified_role is outside the binding's frozen allowed_origins. Only this state may contribute projection-derived wrong-binding evidence, and only when the pre-existing structural witness preconditions also hold.
binding_relation.CERTIFIED_PROJECTION_MATCH: one binding-scoped receipt binds the exact raw_origin to a certified_role derived solely from the embedded canonical projection certificate, and that certified_role is a member of the binding's frozen allowed_origins.
binding_relation.EXACT_BASE_MATCH: raw_origin is literally in allowed_origins; no projection certificate is needed and current behavior is preserved.
binding_relation.UNRESOLVED_AUTHORITY: missing, ambiguous, malformed, unsupported, replayed, context-mismatched, noncanonical, or derivationally circular authority. It must fail closed to assurance-incomplete and must not be promoted into a regression witness merely because raw and allowed strings differ.

dual_view_rule.authority_view: A separate binding_authority_receipt may expose an authorized_role solely to claim-critical A3 allowed-vs-observed role comparison after exact certificate verification.
dual_view_rule.no_implicit_equivalence: Possessing a Gate2C7 world-lookup projection receipt does not by itself authorize A3 binding equivalence.
dual_view_rule.raw_evidence_view: observed_origins, lineage_paths, definition_trace, source_evidence, source hashes, and spans remain byte-for-byte semantic evidence and may never be replaced by resolved base roles.
